Start with a list of every topic you need to cover.

## Make a timetable

Give each topic **two short sessions**, a few days apart.

![A weekly planner](planner.jpg)

## A quick formula

Your average score is $\bar{x} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i$, and on its own line:

$$
\sigma^2 = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}(x_i - \bar{x})^2
$$
